newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - TCI Satellite lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TCI Satellite lowered.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Thursday it lowered its rating on the shares of TCI Satellite Entertainment Inc to a hold from a buy.
-- Further details were not immediately available.

-- PrimeStar Partners said on Wednesday it was re-evaluating its plans to offer Cable Plus, a TCI Satellite service which allows cable companies to supplement their services with a direct-broadcast satellite service.
-- TCI Satellite's shares were off 3/4 at 9-1/8.
